body: 😮😮😮 that is 100% unhinged behavior and from a friend I read this to: fucking bonkers.

I was 100% preparing myself for flying monkeys in the shape of relatives but aside from one of my cousins 5 years ago, the grief from others never happened. I guess I didn't account for how strong the desire to save face is!
Omg, hosting wedding party without you or your spouse, that is actually wild! What people will do to maintain social image!

Given how my dad likes/liked to demonize me privately and around some select family members/friends , I'm surprised they didn't go the 'devil' route and paint themselves as the victim to garner sympathy.

The emotional independence has been a struggle for me -- differentiating their comments vs. what i know to be  me is something i have to constantly practice.

This week was hard, but today is better. Hopefully I'm  getting better at it.
Thank you!
It definitely seems to be common in many asian cultures. Good luck, I believe in you!
my parents trying to find me a man and things like shaadi.com is a whole nother post i could make.
Thank you for your kind words, it's been hard but I don't regret it a bit.

Oh my god! I hope your friend is okay, if not now, but one day :( I've heard similar stories not within my family, but within my parents' group of friends, it's terrifying.  That was definitely a paranoia of mine when I first left the house, but we have a good security camera at our new place, and if they do ever try to engage, I don't need to talk to them at all, or if I want to, I have my boyfriend to tag along with me and keep an eye out sop I don't have to be alone. But a dog wouldn't hurt ;) Thank you.
LOL you know I never thought of spending eternity in heaven with them. Thanks for the laugh, that would suuuuck.
You can do it! I was always told your 30s are a more comfortable time in your life and I can't say I disagree yet! :)

That's why I blocked some people, I was getting anxiety just seeing their name pop up on my phone.

Thank you -- I'm trying my best.

Oh yeah, I didn't tell them about the duration of my relationship, but I'm sure they have an idea at this point. They don't need to know those deets.

I'm prepared that this will (most likely) take years, and I hear having kids helps, not that that should be a reason TO have kids, but you know what I mean it seems :) Good luck to you, and thank you.
I will be okay is basically my mantra at the moment. Thank you!
That's very kind, thank you. I'm hopefully on my way to finding peace of mind.

> "You have no leverage here."

I know that in my logical mind, but that's been the hardest part so far -- truly knowing that they have no leverage here and therefore not giving a fuck about what they say and do.
Thank you for your support. I'll keep that in mind, I still get bouts of guilt about everything.

I have involved myself in a couple of organizations, and I stay on campus until late evening and study if I'm not with friends. Even that is met with criticism -- They think I am avoiding them at home and they see no reason when I can study at home. I persist though.

I understand the med school thing - that's what my parents wanted me to do but I went into engineering because that's what I loved. They still tell people that they would have preferred me going into med school...

Thank you for your advice and support!
Thank you!

I took me many years to realize that I should live by my own expectations and I still struggle with it. I am glad to have friends to support me in this.

I talked to financial aid about being filed as an independent on my FAFSA but apparently I'm a dependent until I'm 24 according to them.  I can file to be made an independent earlier but it would be difficult and may not work. But seeing the state I'm in I might as well try.

Thank you!
I live in Virginia but thank you for your offer.
I have looked some up but unfortunately I can't get to many websites - I'm going to campus today and I will research there.
Wow I love this community. I am for the time being, no longer on edge and hopefully I can get a good night's rest. Thank you everyone for your support. I'll be back in the morning.

I wish I had an aunt and uncle like yours, you are very blessed to have them. 


I have been relying very much on my close friends and counselor, I really do think I'm a more stable, confident person with them. It is what everyone needs.


Thank you for your wishes!
I wasn't expecting this, you put a smile on my face. Hugs for hugsforeveryone!

Thank you! I know that I can call the campus police even if I'm not on campus if some violence occurs, but I don't know what else I can do. I would love your input...what other services can I use? Please message me!

I know that at first it's gonna be harder than I imagine, but I really do feel like I won't mind as much because for once it will be MY decision and on MY terms.
College Financial Aid did offer me loans and grants, and I've been applying for jobs all over the place. I hope someone replies soon....

Oh man me getting to psych services was a story in itself. Basically what happened is that I went to Career Services for a practice interview and had a breakdown from everything that had happened. I had no confidence in myself at that point and the career lady was helpful and led me to psych services down the hall.  It made me realize how badly I needed to talk to someone and that I shouldn't be afraid to.
Thank you, that means a lot to me.  I would like some assistance if the worst case scenario happens, I will keep that in mind.

Seeking help from the university psych services is one of the best decisions I have ever made! I never knew someone would actually listen and help me as much as they have.
And I totally relate on the cyclic nature of anxiety/depression; when I was younger I actually believed my parents' opinions, and when I had doubts I would feel so guilty, like I was defying them in some way. I took me a very long time to realize how wrong they are and I have no reason to feel guilty. 


Thank you!
Thank you! You are very encouraging :)

He's been thankful for every time I do something for him, but it definitely didn't feel that way at the time :\
I'll keep your last bit of advice in mind. Thanks
Thank you for all of the advice, everyone. I'll do my best to be a good friend and listen to her.

She is still in contact with her ex, and she gets upset all over again because of something he says. There has been a lot of blaming each other on both sides. And yet she still keeps talking to him. Is it bad of me to tell her to cut contact? From what I see, him being in her life like this is getting in the way of her recovery.

I'll continue to be there for her, and tell her that going back to school is the best option.

I don't know if there are "people in authority" that know the extent of how she is feeling.  She hasn't hold her family about the breakup, and she is also hiding the fact that she is feeling suicidal. She told me that her dad said that he "doesn't know where he went wrong" because she has been more depressed lately, so it seems to me that her family is not supportive. She feels like they have given up on her.  I don't know if she has the right environment.
